newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INTERLEISURE SURGES AFTER STRONG YR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: INTERLEISURE SURGES AFTER STRONG YR RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in South African entertainment group Interleisure Ltd surged to a new 12-month high on Friday after the firm raised its attributable earnings to 41.5 cents from 25.4 cents in the year ended June 30, dealers said.
By about 0815 GMT Interleisure was up 20 cents at 910 cents with volumes just over 116,000 rand.
"I think this rise is mainly on the back of their results. They had very good results," one dealer at the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.
